yaml:
# Annuaire d'openCloud, exporté par « opencloud export ».
# Les identifiants (id) rattachent chaque entrée à son objet : gardez-les.
# Un jeton ne s'écrit jamais ici : « secret: kept » garde celui du serveur.
version: 1
machines:
  - name: opencloud
  - name: vps-paris-1
projects: []
services:
  - id: svc_ID
    machine: opencloud
    name: backup
    nature: infra
    origin: binary
    units:
      - name: restic
        version: "0.17.1"
        systemd_unit: restic.service
  - id: svc_ID
    machine: vps-paris-1
    name: nextcloud
    title: Nextcloud
    nature: application
    origin: compose
    compose_project: nextcloud
    units:
      - name: nextcloud
        image: nextcloud
        version: "29.0.4"
        ports: ["8080:80"]
        updates: watch
      - name: redis
        image: redis
        version: "7.4"
        updates: watch
probes:
  - id: ID
    name: base nextcloud
    runner: opencloud
    kind: tcp
    target: 127.0.0.1:5432
    interval: 1m
    timeout: 10s
    failure_threshold: 3
    recovery_threshold: 2
  - id: ID
    name: site nextcloud
    runner: vps-paris-1
    service: vps-paris-1/nextcloud
    kind: http
    target: https://cloud.exemple.fr/status.php
    interval: 1m
    timeout: 10s
    failure_threshold: 3
    recovery_threshold: 2
    method: GET
    expected_status: 2xx
    expected_body: installed
heartbeats:
  - id: ID
    name: certbot renew
    every: 12h
    grace: 0s
    token: {secret: kept}
  - id: ID
    name: sauvegarde nextcloud
    machine: vps-paris-1
    every: 24h
    grace: 1h
    token: {secret: kept}
ignored: []
